changes.before: Wide shot a secretary in a riverboat watching wind-driven smoke cross city rooftops, cloudy daylight. Stuart-era city scene: participants look older than children, in dark cloth coats or ankle-length gowns; masonry where construction is shown, no factory-made objects
changes.after: Medium shot on the Thames in 1666, one grey-haired adult in a plain wool doublet sits in a low wooden rowboat watching smoke drift strongly to the right across two small timber-framed house roofs behind him, pale overcast daylight
